scientific_target.question: Do same-record GrC and CF signals jointly improve retrospective prediction of measured contact-onset counts during planned reward delay beyond stage, planned delay, elapsed time, original order and handle movement on complete held-out trials?
scientific_target.known_answer: Integer capacitive-contact0→1 onset counts in every100 ms bin of [0,planned_delay) after movement end:10 bins for1s or20 for2s.
scientific_target.answer_origin: Same learning-imaging record binary contact signal on native200 Hz behavioral ticks; movement end from (trueend−midpt)*dtb, with a genuine preceding sample for interval-start transitions.
scientific_target.case_unit: One complete original trial nested in a calibrated recording session; all frozen10/20 bins form one required response.
scientific_target.independent_unit: Expected five mice and16 imaging sessions in5/5/6 stage groups; actual session-to-mouse mapping needs native evidence and is not proved by group-local indices.
scientific_target.inference_scope: Within-session retrospective count decoding from the full planned window; whole-recording processed inputs and target-dependent sensor QC are disclosed. Joint neural condition is primary; no posthoc best-of arm.
exclusions: No online pre-reward forecasting: actual reward jitter may occur inside planned interval.
No Filio temporal-stretching/dopamine replication or registered-cell transfer.
No fixed-reference gain alone establishes neural attribution; matched context-only candidate and neural ablations are required companions.

inputs: Same-record midAlgn.sigFilt_GrC, binary midAlgn.sp_CF with native neural clocks; handle positions, stage, planned delay, original trial order and elapsed-bin context.
Training/development contact counts only; joint GrC+CF primary, context/handle-only and GrC/CF-only ablations use identical cases.
Full planned-window retrospective observations may enter each prediction; numerical timestamp snapping within1e-9s of100ms boundaries preserves signal values.
